title: CY: 9 November go/no-go meeting agenda with decision owners and evidence
public_pr_body:
Adds tests/GO-NO-GO-MEETING-9-NOV.md: ten ordered plain questions, named decision roles and exact evidence filenames, with Monday outcome/owner/deadline/signature spaces. Monday readiness does not pass the later admin-code checks or authorise Thursday operation; failed/missing evidence stops affected use. Rhys signs the VSR only with complete evidence.

Date Monday 9 November verified. Documentation only; no runtime test, actual meeting, signature, production SQL, main merge or Ready label. Final head 09ca7ea87fa8c8dc7839c33f5e1813b313adfc6d; agenda tightened to 490 words with exact evidence paths. Documentation CI41845171602 completed success. Print layout/actual meeting remain unrun.
